intent_record.intent_summary: Skip firmware logging deinitialization when the feature is unsupported, since no configuration was ever applied.
intent_record.what: In `libie_fwlog_deinit(struct libie_fwlog *fwlog)`, a new early return was added: if `libie_fwlog_supported(fwlog)` is false, the function exits immediately before executing the existing firmware logging shutdown logic. A comment was also added explaining that unsupported firmware logging implies no configuration was performed.
intent_record.how: At runtime, deinitialization now skips the disable/cleanup sequence when firmware logging is not supported, preventing unnecessary operations on configurations that were never initialized. This avoids touching firmware state in unsupported cases while preserving the existing shutdown path when logging is supported.

grouping_result.intent: Skip firmware logging deinitialization when the feature is unsupported, since no configuration was ever applied.

relevance_review.reason: The change directly matches the root cause: it prevents libie_fwlog_deinit() from running teardown when firmware logging was never initialized because the feature is unsupported.
